name: Lefrani
description: Lefrani was a gas giant. It had a strong gravitational pull which prevented Mustafar from becoming a moon of Jestefad.
lead_paragraphs: Lefrani was a gas giant. It had a strong gravitational pull which prevented Mustafar from becoming a moon of Jestefad.
Lefrani eclipsed the star Priate at the precise moment that Darth Vader began assassinating the leaders of the CIS.
